name: step-slider
title: Step slider
description: One named level on a short ordered scale, like summary length or research depth: three to five stops on a rail, the level name above it and a word at each end. The thumb snaps stop by stop and the fill and the name move with it. A ring marks the recommended stop, and a Recommended tag joins the name while the thumb sits there.
